title: Lost Mary Nera15K Fizzy Pineapple Prefilled Vape Pod
description: The Fizzy Pineapple Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod combines tropical sweetness with a sparkling edge. Juicy Pineapple forms the core of the flavour, lifted by a fizzy soda note that adds brightness and a lively finish. It’s a refreshing and tangy vape that’s full of character. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together, they provide up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no coil changes or messy refilling required. Fitted with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures clear flavour and smooth vapour output every time. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and continue vaping. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
